item.title: Owners dismiss possibility of petrol pump shutdown
item.description: Staff Reporter: The Bangladesh Petrol Pump Owners Association has said there is no possibility of fuel stations being permanently shut down, stating that pumps remain open wherever fuel is available and only close temporarily when supplies run out. item.title: DMP gives ultimatum to remove unauthorised roadside businesses
item.description: Staff Reporter: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has ordered the immediate removal of unauthorised shops, extensions, and commercial setups occupying pavements and roads in various parts of the capital. In a notice issued on Monday, the DMP said many restaurants, workshops, and retail outlets have expanded their operations beyond their premises, obstructing footpaths and road […]

item.title: Health minister orders sealing of Doctors Care Hospital and Diagnostic Center in capital
item.description: Staff Reporter: Health and Family Welfare Minister Sardar Md. Sakhawat Husain has ordered the sealing of Doctors Care Hospital and Diagnostic Center located in College Gate area of Shyamoli in the capital following allegations that surgeries were being conducted by fake doctors. The minister took the prompt decision after an unannounced inspection this afternoon, during […]

item.title: Petrol pumps across Bangladesh ‘may shut anytime’
item.description: Staff Reporter: Petrol pump owners in Bangladesh have warned that fuel stations across the country may shut down due to mounting security concerns and an ongoing fuel supply shortage. item.title: Nation to observe symbolic one-minute blackout on 25 March
item.description: Staff Reporter: A one-minute symbolic blackout will be observed across the country on the night of 25 March, marking Genocide Day. The blackout will take place from 10:30pm to 10:31pm, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting said in an official handout on Monday. item.description: Staff Reporter: Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Iqbal Hassan Mahmood has said there is no fuel shortage in the country and that supply remains uninterrupted despite temporary pressure caused by the Eid holidays. item.title: 2 railway staff sued over Cumilla bus-train crash
item.description: Staff Reporter: A case has been filed against two railway staffers in connection with a bus-train collision that left 12 people dead in Cumilla. item.title: Trump sees ‘regime change’ in surprise Iran talks
item.description: Staff Reporter: President Donald Trump said Monday that “regime change” was underway in Iran as the United States held peace talks with an unidentified alternative leader. item.title: Israel’s David’s Sling system failed to intercept Iranian missiles
item.description: Staff Reporter: A malfunction in the David’s Sling aerial interceptor system allowed two Iranian ballistic missiles to strike southern Israel, wounding dozens of people over the weekend, the military confirmed Monday.
